Latin word

sōlus

sōlus, sōla, sōlum

adjective; gen. sōlīus, dat. sōlī · Declension on Wiktionary

alone, by oneself; only, alone, sole

In this lexicon

  • alone

    the recommended word · classical · Mart. 11.35.4: sōlus cēnō; Cic. Off. 3.1: nec minus sōlum quam cum sōlus esset; Traupman 149; Traupman 270

  • only

    also used · classical · Catull. 3.10: ad sōlam dominam; Plaut. Am. 1.1.269 (Lewis & Short)

    I don’t like dining alone, FabullusMart. 11.35.4
